Name: Wooden Playground
Author: Louplex
Description:
[center]✦[size=5] Wooden Playground Recoloration [/size]✦[/center][size=3]
Changes the quirky colors into a wooden design („• ᴗ •„)
[/size][size=3]
It comes with a Toned Version that fits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] best but may work with other Recolorations.
It's toggable via config in the Modfolder (set false to hide and true to show)
or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config Menu[/url].﻿ 
Decide for Original OR Toned (Red Fall/Green Fall) Version! Don't activate both.

Not compatible with other Mods that change the Playground directly, anything surrounding should work fine.
﻿Download via Mod Manager or manually.
If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] needed.[/size]
